div.head: Af 38
div.ab: XXXV. Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdormen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ⁊ wite, swa hit ryht sie, ⁊ beforan þam CXX scill. ðam ealdormen to wite.
XXXV. Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdermen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ond wite, swa hit ryht sy, ⁊ beforan ðam CXX scll' ðam ealdermen to wite.
Be ðam ðe beforan aldormen on gemote feohte. Gyf mon beforan cyninges ealdormen on gemote feohtaþ, bete wer ⁊ wite, swa hit riht sy, ⁊ beforan ðam hundtwelftig scill' ðam ealdormen …
Si quis coram aldermanno regis in placito pugnet, emendet weram et witam, sicut rectum sit, et super hoc CXX sol. ad witam.
[Be ðam ðe beforan aldormen on gemote feohte.] Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdormen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ⁊ wite, swa hit ryht sie, ⁊ beforan þam CXX scill. ðam ealdormen to wite.
{XXXV} Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdormen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ⁊ wite, swa hit ryht sie, ⁊ beforan þam CXX scill ðam ealdormen to wite.

Wenn jemand vor des Königs Ealdorman in der [Gerichts]versammlung ficht, büsse er [des Getroffenen] Wergeld [an die Gegenpartei] und Strafsumme, wie es [je nach der That] sich gebührt, und [noch] vor diesem [Schuldausgleiche] 120 Schill. jenem Ealdorman als Strafgeld.

If someone fights before the king’s ealdorman in the [judicial] assembly, let him pay [the struck man’s] wergeld [to the opposing party] and the fine, as is fitting [according to the deed], and [still] before [all] this 120 shillings to the ealdorman as a fine.

If anyone fights at a meeting in the presence of an ealdorman of the king, he shall pay as compensation [such] wergeld and fine as is due, but previous to this [he shall pay] a fine of 120 shillings to the ealdorman.
If anyone fights in a meeting in the presence of the king’s ealdorman, he is to pay wergild and fine, as it is the law, and before that, 120 shillings to the ealdorman as a fine.

If someone fights in the assembly in the presence of the king’s ealdorman, let him compensate with wer [of the person he injured] and fine, according to the law, and furthermore let him pay 120 shillings to the ealdorman as fine.

Es erhellt nicht, ob Af nur Eine Art Gericht meint
It is not clear whether Af means only one kind of court
‘Wergeld des Missetäters’ missverstehen Inst. = Ps Cn for 17. Dies wäre aber schon ein Strafgeld, also neben der Fechtstrafe sowie dem Gerichtsfriedensbruch undenkbar

Inst. = Ps Cn for 17 misunderstand it as ‘wergild of the wrongdoer’. This, however, would already be a fine, and therefore unthinkable alongside the penalty for fighting and that for breach of the peace of the court
Vgl. o. 7; die Strafe (s. d. Gl 11a. 13) steigt mit der Höhe des an den Verletzten oder an die Sippe des Erschlagenen zu Büssenden und mit der Schwere der Tat
Cf. above 7; the penalty (see that word in Gl 11a. 13) rises with the amount to be paid as compensation to the injured man or to the kindred of the slain, and with the gravity of the deed

Inst. wähnen, es handle sich um Mercischen Schilling zu ¹/₃ Normannischem; so öfter. — Vermutlich als der Friede des höchsten Königsbeamten geniesst der des Ealdorman den hohen Schutz von Königs ‘Ungehorsam’

Inst. imagine that the Mercian shilling, at ¹/₃ of the Norman one, is meant; so more often. — Presumably as the peace of the highest royal official, the ealdorman’s peace enjoys the high protection of the king’s ‘disobedience’
